planComparison: Frozen estimate 850 additions. Actual 278 production additions plus 76 deletions across 11 implementation files; repeated legacy refusal/policy logic was reused instead of padded. Four complete P9 subsection outcomes were implemented in one integrated PR.
newEngineering: P9-1 classification; P9-2 actual guarded Google licensing consent, digest and stored standing policy; P9-3 test/live owner and OAuth issuance with persisted Postgres/HTTPS identity; P9-4 discoverable billing warnings and authenticated reconnect metadata across native/direct paths.
relatedWorkDecision: One substantial coherent P9 A bundle delivered as PR #201; P10 principal-scoped public login remains the designated successor and Hub live-write acceptance is independently Hub-owned. No owner-approved live billable change or unscheduled release performed.
exceptionEvidence: Four original interdependent roadmap subsections are delivered end-to-end across authenticated owner UI, SQL schema, native OAuth issue/refresh, HTTPS RTC, guarded child Licensing API dispatch, catalog and fake-provider/real Postgres tests; meaningful capability coverage matters more than adding a fixed number of lines.

Reused 211 original provenance-guarded write handlers, registered tool schemas and admission tests instead of duplicating hundreds of lines; the available source change is smaller than the frozen estimate precisely because the project already had the needed verified helpers and no production padding is justified.
